voltage-blue.$description: Voltage Blue — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

deep-voltage.$description: Deep Voltage — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

slate-600.$description: Slate 600 — Body text, nav links, icon fills, card secondary copy — the dominant text color across the page

slate-700.$description: Slate 700 — Nav link hover, emphasized body text, secondary headings

slate-500.$description: Slate 500 — Muted helper text, placeholder copy, low-emphasis labels

graphite.$description: Graphite — Subheadings and section titles that sit between body and display weight

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Card surfaces, button text, input fields, nav bar background — the primary elevated surface

fog-50.$description: Fog 50 — Page canvas, section backgrounds, the base layer everything sits on

fog-100.$description: Fog 100 — Alternate section background, subtle hover fills, tag backgrounds

mist-200.$description: Mist 200 — Hairline borders, input borders, card outlines, divider lines

smoke-300.$description: Smoke 300 — Stronger borders, checkbox frames, visible structural edges

inter.$description: Sole typeface across the system. Display sizes (36–64px) use weight 700 with -0.020 to -0.025em tracking to optically tighten the geometric letterforms. Body and UI sizes (14–18px) sit at weight 400–500 with near-normal tracking. Weight 600 is reserved for section titles, weight 700 for the hero headline. The consistent geometric skeleton means no font-mood shift between headline and body — the system speaks in one voice at every size.

balig-script.$description: Balig Script — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
